site.description: A Vietnamese input method engine for IBus, written in Rust. Telex, VNI, VIQR and Microsoft layouts with smart spell check, macros and per-app rules.

lang.hint: Click here to change to a language that suits you

hero.banner_text: v0.1.2 released — Linux · IBus · MIT License
hero.tagline: A Vietnamese keyboard for IBus, written in Rust.
hero.sub_line_1: Telex · VNI · VIQR · Microsoft — smart spell check, macros, per-app rules.
hero.sub_line_2: Tested on Arch Linux, GNOME 51 and Wayland. Needs IBus ≥ 1.5 and GTK4.

about.title: #about
about.subtitle: A Vietnamese input method, rebuilt in Rust.
about.p1: MăngRS is a Vietnamese input method engine for IBus, written in Rust on top of bamboo-core. It brings Telex, VNI, VIQR and the Microsoft layout together with a GTK4 settings window, macros, a custom dictionary and per-app rules.
about.p2: Developed and tested on Arch Linux (IBus 1.5.34, GNOME 51, Wayland; X11 smoke-tested). Other distributions and desktop environments are not tested yet — IBus ≥ 1.5 and GTK4 are the only hard requirements.

features.title: #features
features.subtitle: Everything a Vietnamese typist needs.
features.typing3: Spell check from a bundled 38,350-word list
features.charsets: Unicode · Unicode NFD · TCVN3 · VNI · VIQR · VISCII · VPS · CP1258 · BKHCM · Vietware X · Vietware Full

modes.title: #display-modes
modes.subtitle: Six ways to put Vietnamese on screen.
modes.note: The uinput modes need /dev/uinput and fall back to preedit wherever real-key injection cannot reach the application; on GNOME Wayland they resolve to preedit.

list.desc: The word shows inline with an underline and commits when the word ends.
Every key commits immediately; the tail is rewritten when a mark arrives.
Non-preedit plus a check against the application's own text report.
Raw keys are forwarded while typing; the Latin tail is erased with real Backspaces at word end.
Same as Smooth, without the safety check before rewriting the tail.

list.best: Best for: apps where Backspaces misbehave
list.desc: Shift+← selects the tail, Delete erases it, then the word commits.

install.title: #install
install.subtitle: Install from source. Binary packages are not available yet.
install.online_desc: Downloads the source, builds it and installs it. Needs curl, Rust, IBus, GTK4 and sudo.
install.source_desc: Build the engine, then run the installer.
install.after_desc: Restart IBus, then add Vietnamese → MăngRS in Settings → Keyboard → Input Sources. Switch layouts with Super+Space.
install.note: Binary packages for Arch, Debian/Ubuntu and Fedora/openSUSE are not available yet. Full instructions live in docs/installation.md.

about.title: #giới-thiệu
about.subtitle: Bộ gõ tiếng Việt, viết lại bằng Rust.
about.p1: MăngRS là bộ gõ tiếng Việt cho IBus, viết bằng Rust trên nền bamboo-core. Sản phẩm gộp Telex, VNI, VIQR và kiểu Microsoft cùng cửa sổ cài đặt GTK4, macro, từ điển riêng và quy tắc theo từng ứng dụng.
about.p2: Được phát triển và thử nghiệm trên Arch Linux (IBus 1.5.34, GNOME 51, Wayland; X11 đã thử qua). Các bản phân phối và môi trường đồ họa khác chưa được thử — IBus ≥ 1.5 và GTK4 là hai yêu cầu bắt buộc duy nhất.

site.description: 用 Rust 编写的 IBus 越南语输入法。支持 Telex、VNI、VIQR 和 Microsoft 布局，内置拼写检查、宏和按应用规则。

lang.hint: 点击此处，切换到适合您的语言

hero.banner_text: v0.1.2 已发布 — Linux · IBus · MIT 许可证
hero.tagline: 用 Rust 编写的 IBus 越南语键盘。
hero.sub_line_1: Telex · VNI · VIQR · Microsoft — 拼写检查、宏、按应用规则。
hero.sub_line_2: 已在 Arch Linux、GNOME 51 和 Wayland 上测试。需要 IBus ≥ 1.5 和 GTK4。

about.title: #简介
about.subtitle: 用 Rust 重写的越南语输入法。
about.p1: MăngRS 是一个基于 bamboo-core、用 Rust 编写的 IBus 越南语输入法。它将 Telex、VNI、VIQR 和 Microsoft 布局与 GTK4 设置窗口、宏、自定义词典和按应用规则结合在一起。
about.p2: 在 Arch Linux（IBus 1.5.34、GNOME 51、Wayland；X11 已初步测试）上开发和测试。其他发行版和桌面环境尚未测试 — IBus ≥ 1.5 和 GTK4 是唯一的硬性要求。

features.title: #功能
features.subtitle: 越南语输入所需的一切。
features.typing1: 新式声调位置（hòa）或传统方式（hoà）
features.typing3: 使用内置 38,350 词词表进行拼写检查
features.typing4: 自动恢复非越南语单词
features.typing7: 自动大写，双空格 → 句号
features.charsets: Unicode · Unicode NFD · TCVN3 · VNI · VIQR · VISCII · VPS · CP1258 · BKHCM · Vietware X · Vietware Full

modes.title: #显示模式
modes.subtitle: 六种将越南语显示到屏幕的方式。
modes.note: uinput 模式需要 /dev/uinput，在无法向应用注入真实按键时会回退到 preedit；在 GNOME Wayland 上会作为 preedit 运行。

list.desc: 单词带下划线显示在行内，并在单词结束时提交。
每个按键立即提交；出现声调时重写词尾。
在 non-preedit 基础上，与应用自身报告的文本进行校验。
输入时转发原始按键；单词结束时用真实 Backspace 删除拉丁词尾。
与 Smooth 相同，但在重写词尾前不做安全检查。

list.best: 适合：Backspace 表现异常的应用
list.desc: Shift+← 选中词尾，Delete 删除，然后提交单词。

install.title: #安装
install.subtitle: 从源码安装。目前尚未提供二进制安装包。
install.online_desc: 下载源码、构建并安装。需要 curl、Rust、IBus、GTK4 和 sudo。
install.source_desc: 构建引擎，然后运行安装脚本。
install.after_desc: 重启 IBus，然后在 设置 → 键盘 → 输入源 中添加 越南语 → MăngRS。用 Super+Space 切换布局。
install.note: Arch、Debian/Ubuntu 和 Fedora/openSUSE 的二进制安装包尚未提供。完整说明见 docs/installation.md。
